description.value: Langley Farm Market is a Metro Vancouver grocery chain with over 25 years of history, built around fresh, locally sourced BC produce delivered directly from regional farms. The Pitt Meadows location is one of six across the region, stocking everything from Okanagan fruit and organic vegetables to fresh meat, seafood, deli cold cuts, and in-store baked goods. The market won the 2025 Vancouver Consumer Choice Award for Best Fruit & Vegetable Market, making it a well-regarded stop for cyclists seeking quality provisions.
